summary: Natural, polite ordering and a real back-and-forth with Luis. Next time ask the price before Maria tells you, and reach for «¿mande?» when you lose the thread instead of switching to English.

scores.comment: «Quiero un café de olla y una concha, por favor» — clear request form, no pointing.
You asked «¿cuánto es?» only after Maria said the total.
Four exchanges with full clauses; a couple of one-word answers in the middle.
«¿Y las tortugas salen todas las noches?» picked up Luis's turtle patrol.
«¿Para tomar aquí o para llevar?» answered in Spanish after a pause.
Switched to English once when you missed a word; try «¿cómo?» or «más despacio, por favor».
